messages:
ACME - Jordan (customer): Hey team — seeing audit events in our SIEM stop around ~07:55 PT. We rely on Redwood Private audit logs. Any known issues?

Camila Reyes: thanks Jordan. just to confirm: this is the audit-log-exporter output (not the app logs), right?

ACME - Jordan (customer): Yep. exporter -> our webhook. It was steady yesterday. Today nothing for ~30+ min.

Avery Johnson: do we have exporter version + deploy type? Dedicated vs Private?

ACME - Jordan (customer): Dedicated. exporter image tag `audit-log-exporter:v1.9.2` (from our values.yaml).

Ethan Park: checking metrics… seeing elevated queue depth on a couple dedicated clusters. might be backpressure in exporter.

Camila Reyes: going to open a SUP ticket so we can track.

Incident Bot: created Jira ticket SUP-4812 (customer-support) for this thread.

Avery Johnson: workaround idea: restart exporter pod + bump `EXPORT_BATCH_MAX_AGE_SEC`? but want to verify before advising.

Ethan Park: quick check: exporter logs show `retrying send: 429 from customer endpoint` then queue never drains. Looks like we’re not dropping/compacting on retry.

Camila Reyes: Jordan — can you confirm if your webhook started rate limiting us (429)? If so, we can coordinate a lower send rate or adjust exporter config.

ACME - Jordan (customer): We did roll out a WAF policy this morning; could be blocking bursts. But even after allowlisting, logs aren’t catching up.

Avery Johnson: if allowlist is in place and we’re still stuck, likely exporter wedged. Restart should unblock but might lose buffered events depending on memory pressure.

Camila Reyes: ok, let’s recommend restart as immediate mitigation + we’ll follow up with root cause.

Camila Reyes: Jordan — please restart the exporter deployment (rolling restart). If logs resume, we’ll treat as mitigation and continue investigation under SUP-4812.

ACME - Jordan (customer): Restarted. Logs resumed after ~2 min. Still missing ~40 min worth though.

Ethan Park: ack. will dig on whether we drop in-memory queue under backpressure. linking eng shortly.
